integrity_note: The proof is mathematical and self-contained; independent finite enumeration corroborates coefficients for one to five pages and structural counting through six pages. No independent audit or independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The result treats only books of four-cycles with a shared spine and does not apply to general prisms of trees or polygonal books. The numerical two-page maximum is already implied by a known grid theorem. A complete priority search of inaccessible or unindexed work is not guaranteed.
title: Edge-general-position polynomials of quadrilateral books
